purpose: Prespecified native SARscope evaluation, not historical preprocessing emulation or proprietary field parity
freeze_statement: Source metadata, graph uniqueness and stereo completeness inspected before freezing. No SARscope test scores from these datasets inspected before this protocol. All declared cases and failures retained; no test-based configuration selection.
data_license: Upstream repository CC BY-SA 4.0; source SDFs fetched for local use, not bundled. Derived evidence attributed.

datasets.name: AChE
datasets.endpoint: historical acetylcholinesterase pIC50 benchmark; not assumed assay-homogeneous
datasets.activity_transform: identity; deposited log activity, no new endpoint conversion

datasets.name: CCR5
datasets.endpoint: historical CCR5 antagonist log activity; source labels retained, not inferred pIC50 conversion
datasets.activity_transform: identity; deposited log activity, no new endpoint conversion

datasets.name: THR
datasets.endpoint: historical thrombin pKi benchmark; not assumed assay-homogeneous
datasets.activity_transform: identity; deposited log activity, no new endpoint conversion

source_screening_notes: ACE and THERM have duplicate encoded training graphs and need grouped CV; not silently deduplicated or used as clean random-fold benchmarks. Selection here is based on input quality, not model scores.
metadata_correction: Initial native-validation-20261016 run recorded 'kfold', not the ModelParams literal 'default'. Both take the same ordinary K-fold runtime branch; the initial evidence remains untouched. This corrects configuration validation/metadata only, not fields, selection or evaluation settings, after seeing the initial results.

interpretation.unit: Each method/target is a separate evaluation, not a pooled activity endpoint
interpretation.software_verification: Successful calculation or poor predictive performance is not by itself proof of a correct or incorrect algorithm
interpretation.model_qualification: Use the existing run-level checks; a failed gate remains failed. Skipped alignment-core QC does not pass alignment validation.
interpretation.independence: New-to-SARscope evaluations on public historical test splits, not blinded, prospective or independent-laboratory validation
interpretation.no_claim: This campaign cannot by itself certify the package, establish proprietary CoMFA/CoMSIA parity, validate generated alignment, or establish universal predictive superiority
